subject: Re: Remediation compensation request after 2027-11-15 incident
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@aurora.ai>

Cc: Aurora Support <support@aurora.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Nov 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request for remediation compensation after 11/15 outage

Karthik,

Thanks for the update in the postmortem. Aurora saw a 92-minute window of increased error rates on 2027-11-15 that directly impacted our inference traffic and caused request timeouts for production models. Our team has quantified customer impact and is requesting an SLA remediation credit under our service agreement.

Summary we captured:
- Incident window: 2027-11-15 02:03 - 03:35 UTC (approx 92 mins)
- Impact: 7.8% of requests returned 5xx or timed out during the window
- Estimated billable compute affected: 1,200 node-minutes across our reserved pool

We'd like Redwood to review eligibility and provide the credit calculation and next steps. Please let me know what information you need from us; I've attached the incident export we use for our accounting.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — this will feed into our quarter-end reconciliation.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Reliability, AuroraAI

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request for remediation compensation after 11/15 outage

Karthik / Priyom — I pulled the raw uptime windows and ran the credit calc against Aurora's contract (Committed Reserved, SLA table v2). Summary below and attached workbook (credit_calc_aurora_20271121.xlsx):

- Eligible downtime: 1.533 hours (92 minutes)
- Monthly committed units: 43,200 node-minutes
- Fraction of month affected = 1.533 / (30 * 24) = 0.00213
- Monthly committed fee: $72,000
- Pro-rated credit = $72,000 * 0.00213 = $153.36
- Per SLA terms we round to the nearest dollar and issue as a one-time invoice credit: $153

Sign-off required: Finance lead (Marissa) + Revenue Ops (Priyom) for credits > $100. Also asked legal to confirm no additional contravening terms — Laura cc'd.

If you want us to increase to a goodwill gesture (Aurora is a strategic customer), we can add a discretionary top-up. Suggest $1,000 voucher in addition to the contractual credit; needs approval from LAURA.

Attaching: credit_calc_aurora_20271121.xlsx (breakdown) and a draft credit memo template.

Marissa
Director, Billing & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Laura Bennett

Samir — thank you for your patience while we validated the timeline. Attached is the credit memo (credit_memo_aurora_20271122.pdf) and a short explanation of the calculation. Key points:

- Contractual remediation credit calculated: $153 (pro-rated per SLA v2)
- Discretionary goodwill voucher applied: $1,000 (not deducted from your paid balance; issued as an account voucher valid for 12 months)

We sincerely apologize for the disruption and are tracking the regression in our telemetry dashboards. For full details, see our postmortem: https://drive.redwood.com/incident/2027-11-15/postmortem.

If you'd like a short call to walk through the calculation I can be available today at 2pm PT.
